description: University Grants Commission- The Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 Amendment to the Swami Vipulananda Institute of Astnetic Studies Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to an existing ordinance (The Swamy Vipulananda Institute of Aesthetic Studies Ordinance) made by the University Grants Commission under statutory authority. It involves legal modifications to institutional structures, departments, and administrative procedures, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
